concerns.text: Task T010a (Load Human Ratings CSV) is scheduled **before** its producer T012 (Persist Human Ratings), violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.
Task T010 (Compute Pilot Correlation) depends on the human‑ratings CSV created by T012, yet it is placed **before** T012.
Task T020 (Handle No‑Object Images) is a test that assumes the metric extraction implementation (T019) exists, but T020 is listed **before** T019.
Task T021 (Persist Metrics CSV) depends on the output of T019, but it appears **before** the implementation task.
Unit test T015 (test_entropy_calculation) is scheduled **before** the metric extraction code (T019) that it is meant to test.
Unit test T016 (test_color_variance_calculation) is placed **before** the implementation task T019.
Integration test T017 (test_yolov8n_cpu_inference) runs **before** the metric extraction implementation T019, creating a consumer‑before‑producer ordering error.
Contract test T018 (test_blank_background_edge_case) is listed **before** the code (T019) it validates.
Performance test T061 depends on the metric extraction pipeline (T019) but is positioned **before** T019.
Data integration task T036 requires artifacts produced by T021 (metrics CSV), T055 (clip difficulty), and T031 (participant sessions), all of which are defined **later** in the plan.
Task T032a (Dataset Version & Source Recording) is described as recording metadata **when fetching** clips (T032) yet it is placed **before** the fetch task T032.
Task T014a is marked with the `[P]` parallel‑safe tag, but the description explicitly states the task is **not parallel‑safe** and must complete before dependent tasks.
